annotations.title: Remove a Page's DM entry points

description:
[DESTRUCTIVE] DESTRUCTIVE: removes the ice breakers, and on Facebook also the greeting, menu and Get Started button, from the account; every visitor stops seeing them. Confirm with the user first.
(Wraps DELETE /api/v2/accounts/{id}/entry-points.)

brandId.description: An id from GET /api/v2/brands, or "personal". Omitted → the key's bound brand, else the owner's personal accounts.

id.description: An Instagram or Facebook account id from GET /api/v2/accounts.

name: clear_dm_entry_points
title: Remove a Page's DM entry points
